metadata.name: Lab carbonate chemistry of Mytilus galloprovincialis
metadata.description: Laboratory measurements of seawater carbonate system parameters (pH, temperature, salinity, total alkalinity, dissolved inorganic carbon, CO₂, bicarbonate, carbonate, calcium, and saturation states) for the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis. Includes treatment (Control/Other), exposure time in hours (2–144 h), and developmental stage. All samples were collected at a single site (Nagasaki University).
metadata.temporal: exposure duration recorded in hours (2–144 h); timestamps are sub‑second artifacts of epoch conversion
